name: Switchyard
summary: A black-and-neon payments console for a card processor, with a live pipeline of every payment
about: A back-office console for a company that takes card payments for other businesses, filled with sample data from a small processor. Payments stream in about once a second and fly through an authorize, capture and settle pipeline, while declines drop out in red. It covers transactions with refunds, a drag-and-drop dispute board, merchants, payout batches, risk rules with a tester, analytics and team settings.
how: Watch the Live page: dots fly through the pipeline, the stream adds rows and the approval gauge moves
Open a payment to see its timeline and risk score, then refund it with a confirm step
Drag disputes between stages, or press a card's menu button and pick Move to
Search, filter and export merchants and payouts, or run a payout batch and watch it complete
Turn risk rules on and off, add your own, and test a payment to see which rule fires
Switch Analytics between 7D, 30D and 12M to morph the volume chart
